_comment: Who is selling. `entity: null` is the DESIGNED state until the owner decides the selling entity (CLAUDE.md §37G) -- the three legal pages render with an operator placeholder and the product must not go live that way: docs/deploy-runbook.md's smoke list includes checking these pages show the entity. FILLING THIS IN IS ALSO SIGN-OFF on the page text in views.mjs -- the pages render whatever stands here, escaped, and nothing else reads this file. addressLines render one per line on /impressum and /privacy; email becomes the contact address on all three pages and must actually receive mail (the domain has no MX until Email Routing exists -- §37G). vatId may stay null until one exists.
